______ is a promise or set of promises which is legally binding on both the promisor and the promise and is therefore enforceable in law (Kachikwu and Ozekhome, 1988).
contract
A contract is a promise or set of promises which is legally binding on both the promisor and the promise and is therefore enforceable in law (Kachikwu and Ozekhome, 1988).
______ is derived from the common customs of the Realm and from the principles, which the Judges of the Curia Regis have built around it in the Royal Courts of old.
Common law

______ is a contract in which one or more of the parties has power, if he desires so to do, to avoid the legal relations imposed by the contract.
voidable contract
A voidable contract is a contract in which one or more of the parties has power, if he desires so to do, to avoid the legal relations imposed by the contract.
